evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies net_processing, TxDownloadManager, and TxOrphanage.
rationale: Fixes four edge-case relay bugs where same-txid transaction variants can stall CPFP package propagation and poison reject filters. A peer sending a witnessless parent variant or triggering reconsiderable feerate failures can currently evict valid orphan children, cancel honest parent download requests, or reject subsequent children until confirmation.
